title: Cozy Cabana in East Nashville with EV Charging
description:
Enjoy this unique backyard experience just minutes from downtown and within walking distance of Las Maracas and Nicoletto's!  Nestled in a corner of a 1 acre lot, you’ll have plenty of privacy with the convenience of NashVegas.  You'll have access to our tiny house with 1 double bed and 1 pullout sofa, fire pit, and plenty of parking...including EV charging (NEMA 14-50).  Contact me for details!

The space
Wanna visit Nashville but without the hustle and bustle of downtown? Enjoy s’mores over the fire pit, roast hot dogs, or walk to grab grub.  Our 250 sq ft tiny house has 1 double bed and 1 pullout sofa, a kitchenette, and a full bath.  Comforters, sheets, pillows, shampoo, towels, toilet paper, paper towels, coffee, hair dryer and ample firewood are provided.  Wifi is available but **does not** always work inside the cabana.  Some guest have no problem accessing it at the fire pit or on our front porch. (working on that).  Short showers are a MUST as the cabana has an RV water heater.

Diversity welcomed!  Cats or dogs, young or older, gay or straight...all ethnicities....seriously all are welcome here!

Guest access
Closer to your check in date, I will send a reminder with instructions and key code.

Other things to note
We have crazy dogs so if you are allergic or don't care for pets, sadly this is not the place for you.
